stops.note: the name for the leaf chewed with areca nut
Portuguese traders in Kerala met the leaf, chewed with areca nut across South and Southeast Asia
Marco Polo had already described the chewing of betel in the 1290s
stops.meaning: a leaf chewed as a mild stimulant

current_meaning: the leaf of a plant chewed with areca nut as a mild stimulant in parts of Asia
